name: Chou Shiritsu! Onna no Ko-sama Gakuen
source:
The main character is a painfully average boy with high school graduation looming before his very eyes.

Unsure of what to do next in his life, and he wanders his way through his precious few remaining school days. But then one day...

He runs into a girl, a former classmate who transferred schools 2 years ago. Her name is Minahara Rinko -- and she was his very first love, a love that only existed in his mind, never to come to fruition in reality.

Rinko, smiling as brightly as ever, held a single mysterious DVD in hand...

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034454.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名平凡得不能再平凡的高三男生，转眼高中毕业已近在眼前。

对未来去向一片迷茫的他，正浑浑噩噩地虚度着所剩无几的宝贵校园时光。直到某一天……

他在街头重逢了一名少女——两年前转学离开的昔日同班同学三奈原凛子。她正是主人公人生中的初恋，一段只深埋于心底、从未在现实中开花结果的单相思。

凛子脸上绽放着一如往昔的灿烂笑容，手中却攥着一张神秘的DVD光盘……

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034454.html]DLSite English[/url]]
